mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of instances during FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% triggers a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains above 4.0% for >30 days without negative returns, or t-test p-value > 0.05 for 20d returns during the period.

mechanism_narrative: Excessive demand growth (GDPC1) relative to supply growth (INDPRO) triggers inflationary pressures, prompting the Fed to raise rates and compress equity valuations, resulting in negative 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth exceeds INDPRO growth in the same month by at least 1.0 percentage points
failure_condition: The interaction does not predict negative returns with IC > 0.1 over any 6-month window, or 20d returns are not significantly negative (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in unemployment rates (UNRATE) below 5.0% during a late-cycle expansion signals labor market strength, boosting growth expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 5.0% in a late-cycle expansion regime
failure_condition: UNRATE remains above 5.0% in the late-cycle expansion, or 60d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS) coupled with falling unemployment (UNRATE) creates a tight labor supply, stimulating economic activity and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >2% while UNRATE decreases by >0.5 percentage points in the same month
failure_condition: The interaction does not correlate with positive returns (IC < 0.15), or returns revert within 5 days without sustained gains.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates (UNRATE) falling below 4.0% signal a tight labor market, driving productivity gains and positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE remains ≥4.0% despite positive returns, or returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rapid growth in demand (GDPC1) without corresponding supply growth (RSAFS) creates inflationary pressures, leading the Fed to raise rates and compress equity valuations, resulting in negative 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth exceeds RSAFS growth by >1.0 percentage points in the same month
failure_condition: The interaction does not predict negative returns (IC > 0.1), or 20d returns are not significantly negative (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Surge in both industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals an over-supplied economy, prompting the Fed to raise rates and compress equity valuations, leading to negative 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: Both INDPRO and HOUST increase by >5% in the same month
failure_condition: The interaction does not correlate with negative returns (IC < 0.03 over 3-year window), or 60d returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
